structured_output.what_is_happening: A pump.fun token 'Grokbotification' ($GROKBOTIFY) graduated to PumpSwap within ~1 minute of creation (~07:18-07:19 UTC) and ran +250% to ~$170-177k mcap in its first ~36 minutes on ~$255k volume. Its only social link is a Sep 18, 2026 Korean-language viral X post by @Multi_Serio_Ai (3.5k followers; ~9.3k likes, ~5.8M views) sharing a prompt to create 'Grok bot-style' characters, riding the Aug 11, 2026 launch of xAI's Grok Bot agent product. The creator has already closed out (creator_close) and the token is flagged community takeover. At least 10 other 'Grokbotification' tokens were launched over the prior ~2 days; this one is simply the launch that caught volume.

narrative.description: Meme around a viral Korean X post (Sep 18) sharing a prompt to generate 'Grok Bot'-style characters, which piggybacks on xAI/SpaceXAI's Grok Bot agent product launched Aug 11, 2026. The coined word 'Grokbotification' does not appear anywhere in indexed web/X content; it seems to be the deployers' own name for the trend.
narrative.why_spreading: The source tweet had big reach (5.8M views), but it is 5 days old and was already farmed by many copycat launches from ~Sep 21 onward. Current attention looks like pump.fun trench rotation into the one copy that graduated, not a new external catalyst. I found no fresh X, Reddit, news or Telegram discussion of the token or the term.

token_connection.why_this_token: It links the viral source tweet and is the only same-name token with real liquidity/volume (others < $8k mcap). It is not tied to the tweet author; it's a third-party launch now marked as community takeover after the creator exited.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 10 same-name tokens in the packet (GROKBOT, GROKBOTIFY, Grokbotify) created from ~Sep 21 onward; the earliest (FTymiRX..., created ~1789973296) predates this one by ~2 days. 45xNi5... was launched ~5 min earlier and did $19k h1 volume but is now ~$3.3k mcap. Separately, older $GROKBOT tokens tied to xAI's Grok Bot product exist (e.g., R14Fyw...pump, ATH Aug 25, now -99%).

authenticity.evidence: GMGN reports 170 bundler wallets, top_bundler_trader_pct 51.5%, 20 snipers, and a 31-wallet insider transfer network; the token graduated ~71 seconds after creation (bundled launch); the creator has closed out; GeckoTerminal security score is 39/100. There are no paid boosts, and smart-money/KOL signals are nil, so I found no evidence of organic outside attention.
authenticity.uncertainty: GMGN bundler tags can overcount. The ~900 unique buyers in h1 suggest real retail participation from the pump.fun trenches. X content is poorly indexed, so organic posts could exist that I couldn't see.

structural_risks: Bundler wallets account for ~51.5% of top-trader activity; heavy supply overhang from bundled/sniped entries
Liquidity only ~$37k against a ~$177k market cap; thin exits
Price already +250% and near the ATH ($0.0001898) within 36 minutes
Creator exited and it's marked CTO; no team or roadmap

structured_output.counterargument: Grok/xAI is one of the strongest meme themes in crypto, and the source tweet had real mass reach (5.8M views). This token is clearly the winning copy, with ~900 unique buyers in an hour, locked/burned LP, and renounced authorities. A CTO community could keep the momentum going, and any fresh Grok Bot news or an Elon post using 'grokbot' could re-ignite it toward higher market caps.
unknowns: Actual X discussion volume around $GROKBOTIFY right now (X is poorly indexed; I couldn't read the tweet on x.com directly)
Whether the CTO group has an active Telegram
The true share of supply held by bundlers vs. real holders (GMGN page blocked)
Whether any fresh Grok Bot news is landing in the next hours

source_coverage.notes: I read the linked X post via the fxtwitter API (x.com returned 402). Searches for the contract address, $GROKBOTIFY, the name and site:x.com found nothing token-specific. News coverage is only about xAI's Grok Bot product. There is no project website. The GMGN page returned 403. DexScreener and GeckoTerminal were fetched.

structured_output.thesis: A bundled pump.fun launch using the name of a 5-day-old viral Korean Grok Bot prompt tweet. It is one of 10+ copycats, the creator has exited, and it sits near its ATH on thin liquidity. I found no fresh catalyst or organic discussion. Attention is probably trench rotation and likely to fade.
